mutationRules: Never trust client-supplied authority or actor identity.
Resolve ROOT_OWNER from the authenticated server session.
Validate level, class, stat, skill, zone and coordinate limits server-side.
Item create, edit, remove and transfer operations must be transactional.
Every mutation must create an append-only audit event with actor, target, reason, source and traceId.
Critical world/server actions require re-authentication before execution.
The browser must never connect directly to the game database.
